page.layout: One block of text, centred at the top of the page: three numbered list lines, then an italic rubric with a number beneath it. Below it, a library stamp and faint show-through from the other side. At the foot, a gathering mark.

main_text.l: 5. De magistris, & ne aliquid exi-gatur pro licentia docendi.
main_text.head: Postremò Extravagantes Ioannis XXII.

page.notes: The Stadtbibliothek Zürich stamp is omitted. Faint mirrored text below the stamp and at the left-centre is show-through and is omitted. The signature "L 5" at the foot is very faint, so the reading is uncertain. The line "affinita-te." is split across two printed lines with a printed hyphen. The line "exi-gatur" is likewise split with a printed hyphen.
